title: He Was Just A Quiet Pawnbroker . . . Until A Gang Took The Little Girl Next Door (The Man from Nowhere)
caption:
In The Man from Nowhere (2010), a silent pawnbroker's only friend is the lonely little girl next door. When a drug gang takes her and her mother, he comes out of hiding. Follow for more movie recaps!

#themanfromnowhere #koreanmovie #movierecap #thriller #spoilerroom
comment: Would you have gone after a whole gang for your neighbor's kid? Why?

segments.say: A man stands covered in blood in the dark. A little girl looks up and asks him one thing.

segments.text: Mister, are you here to save me?

segments.say: To see how it got here, go back to a tiny *pawnshop*.
Jack runs it alone. He keeps his hood up, his mouth shut, and nobody bothers him.
Only one person gets through. A lonely little girl next door named *Lily*.
She eats at his counter and tells him her dream. She wants to open a *nail shop*.
Once she pays him with her favorite trading card. Jack keeps it, and that says a lot.
Jack barely answers her. But he never sends her *away*.
Her mother, Anna, is a mess, and she is mixed up with a *drug gang*.
One night Anna steals a bag of *heroin* from that gang.
Their boss finds out. He wants it back, and he wants someone to *pay*.
He gives two brothers, Mike and Sam, a short deadline. Find the thief, or *else*.
Soon, thugs drag Anna and Lily out into the night. Taking the girl next door was their first *mistake*.
Then they turn to Jack, the quiet man next door. They have a job for him.
Do one delivery, and Anna and Lily live. Say no, and they *die*.
Jack gives in. He will do whatever they ask, as long as the girl stays *safe*.
So Jack becomes their courier. He drives a bag of drugs across town in the *rain*.
The drop is a golf range office. A man named Oh waits there with his Chinese *buyers*.
Jack hands the package over, and then the whole deal blows up in their *faces*.
Cops roll in. The boss's men turn on Jack, and he *runs*.
A crowd of armed men chases him across the lot. Bad *idea*.
Then comes the worst news. Anna is dead. The gang took her organs and sold *them*.
A detective named Ford looks Jack up. His record is locked, and nobody has ever seen a civilian file like *that*.
Meanwhile Ford's bosses try to hand the case to the secret service. Ford refuses to let *go*.
Ford digs deeper and finds the truth. Jack was a *special agent*, trained to kill.
The pawnshop was just a *hiding place*.
Years earlier, Jack had a wife who was about to have his *baby*.
Then enemies from his old job found her, and Jack was too late to stop *it*.
She died in front of him, and so did the future he had *planned*.
After that, he hid in a pawnshop and felt nothing. Until a little girl wouldn't leave him *alone*.
Now Jack is hurt and burning with fever. He hides in a junkyard with an old friend who *helps*.
Then he shaves his head, and the quiet pawnbroker is *gone*.
A phone call tells him what he needs to hear. Lily is still *alive*.
That is all he needs. One man, no backup, against a whole *gang*.
Meanwhile Lily sits in a dark room with Ryan and an old woman. They tell her to behave, and she will see her *mom*.
Jack starts at a nightclub, where the gang's dealers hang *out*.
He corners a young dealer in the men's room and asks one question. Where are Mike and *Sam*?
Before he gets an answer, a hired killer named Ryan steps in with a *gun*.
The fight wrecks the bathroom, but Jack gets *away*.
Jack finally gets Mike on the phone. And Mike brags about what they did to *Anna*.
Then Jack asks about Lily. Mike says she is alive. For *now*.
The trail leads to a port, where Jack shakes down a street dealer. He shows him Lily's *photo*.
The dealer talks. The gang buys kids from desperate families and uses them as drug *runners*.
Next stop is a hidden clinic, where the gang cuts organs out of people for *money*.
Jack takes out every man in the building, one at a *time*.
But Lily isn't there. So Jack grabs Sam, Mike's little *brother*.
Then he calls Mike. Bring Lily here in one hour. No more *deals*.
Mike screams threats back. He has no idea who he is *dealing* with.
Behind Jack, a whole building goes up in a fireball. Jack does not do *subtle*.
Mike waits in his marble mansion with a small army. Jack walks in *alone*.
Mike asks who the hell he is.
Mike wants his brother back. Jack wants Lily *first*.
Then Mike gives the order. Kill *him*.
A dozen men rush Jack at once. He fights them all with guns, knives, and bare *hands*.
When the dust settles, Jack is bleeding from head to toe, and the floor is covered in men. Mike picked the wrong *fight*.
Then Ryan steps up, the gang's hired killer. They fight blade to blade, and Jack *wins*.
Mike hides in a bulletproof car in the garage and screams for the *police*.
But Jack still has one bullet. It is all he *needs*.
Jack staggers out of the garage, bleeding from his eye, and Lily is standing in the *dark*.
Jack tells her to stay back, because he is covered in blood. She runs into his arms *anyway*.
Later, Lily is safe. Jack lost an eye to get her *back*.

segments.text: I am sorry that I turned away back then.

segments.say: For the first time, Lily sees him *smile*.
Then he asks if he can hug her. And the hardest man in the city starts to *cry*.
A man with nothing left to lose found one little girl worth killing *for*.
